info.title: Traigent Guided Generation Routes
info.description: Routes that issue opaque GuidancePlans and ingest content-free generation results. Session guidance conveys selection without proprietary tuning signals; cold-start guidance conveys only content-free local capabilities and bounded budgets.

200.description: Cold-start plan issued with opaque identity, protocol, descriptor digest, candidate limit, and expiry.

400.description: Invalid request: the closed `{loc, type, msg}` validation list (no submitted value or client key is echoed); this route omits `error_code`.

422.description: Descriptor is schema-valid but declares no local scoring authority (or no local generation capability), so no plan is issued and cold start is discovery-only. Body is `{error, reason}` with a fixed phrase and a closed `reason` code. A write sent with no explicit project is also refused with 422 (`code` PROJECT_CONTEXT_REQUIRED, see projects/write_scope_error_schema.json).

429.description: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded.

500.description: Unhandled failure. The catch-all handler returns the closed `{success, error, code}` body with a fixed phrase; no exception text, no request id.

post.summary: Request a GuidancePlan for a session
post.description: Returns a deterministic, opaque GuidancePlan derived server-side from proprietary tuning signals. The response carries selection only: no signal names, values, or formulas.

400.description: Invalid request: the closed `{loc, type}` validation list with error_code VALIDATION_ERROR (no submitted value or client key is echoed).

404.description: Session not found for the canonical tenant context.

422.description: Write sent with no explicit project: send the `X-Project-Id` header or use a project-bound API key. Closed body, nothing from the request is echoed.

429.description: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded.

500.description: Unhandled failure. The catch-all handler returns the closed `{success, error, code}` body with a fixed phrase; no exception text, no request id.

post.summary: Submit content-free generation results for a GuidancePlan
post.description: Reports per-seed generation counts and deterministic new-example ids for a previously issued plan. Carries no prompt text or example content. The plan_token is echoed back for verification.

400.description: Invalid request: the closed `{loc, type}` validation list with error_code VALIDATION_ERROR (no submitted value or client key is echoed).

404.description: Session not found for the canonical tenant context.

409.description: plan_token invalid, expired, does not match the session, or results do not match the signed plan.

422.description: Write sent with no explicit project: send the `X-Project-Id` header or use a project-bound API key. Closed body, nothing from the request is echoed.

429.description: Too many requests — rate limit exceeded.

500.description: Unhandled failure. The catch-all handler returns the closed `{success, error, code}` body with a fixed phrase; no exception text, no request id.
